name: GOLD
placementNote: Creative mic-color stage after a level-matched reference comparison; use only when deliberate harmonic character is wanted.
description: M50-referenced input response followed by deliberate harmonic color for body, presence, soul, weight, and dimensional lift. GOLD is a creative color stage, not an automatic correction or neutral reference.

presetDescriptions.Canon Open: Canon Open — Neutral GOLD starting point: keep the mic/source array centered and compare the color lanes at equal loudness before adding presence.
presetDescriptions.Source True: Source True — Preserves the microphone’s identity while the GOLD color path stays restrained; use it as a source-first vocal or acoustic reference.
presetDescriptions.Root Anchor: Root Anchor — Centers the lower body and Fe Weight so the source has a stable foundation without a hyped top.
presetDescriptions.Earth Hold: Earth Hold — Adds grounded body and authority for thin or wandering sources; check the low-mid against the arrangement before increasing level.
presetDescriptions.Body Open: Body Open — Balances Cu Body with Ag Air so a dense source gains chest and breathing room together.
presetDescriptions.Spirit Lift: Spirit Lift — Moves emphasis toward Au Presence/Pt Authority for articulation and lift after the source has a solid center.
presetDescriptions.Sacred Push: Sacred Push — A forward, colored GOLD push for a lead that must sit above the bus; match output before deciding it is better.
presetDescriptions.Full Field: Full Field — The broadest GOLD color field: body, presence, and air are all engaged for a deliberate finished source rather than a neutral capture.

name: SILVER
placementNote: Neutral reference stage: establish a level-matched baseline before deciding whether GOLD color is musically useful.
description: M50-referenced neutral source voicing for truthful level and tone comparisons: air, articulation, transient precision, and spatial reveal. SILVER is a reference voicing, not an automatic correction or universal flat-response promise.

name: ANUBIS
description: Dynamics gate and guard with threshold, ratio, attack, hold, release, range, a named stereo host Sidechain bus, independent Sidechain Key and Sidechain Duck operation, protected I/O, and parallel mix.

meters.reading: Shows the program feeding the gate.
OPEN is full passage; lower values mean attenuation.
Moves only when a host sidechain is routed.
More fill means deeper ducking of the main signal.
Compare with IN to judge actual attenuation.
Shows where the signal opens and how far closure may fall.
Gold is coherent, purple is spread, red warns of anti-phase risk.

name: DIH Drum Morpher
description: Sixteen-pad DIH drum sampler and host-timeline sequencer with sample loading, pad shaping, restored factory programs, pattern memory, capture, live sidechain/MPC morph, and performance controls. The current 1.0.1 factory bank is organized around distinct modern patterns including 808, trap, R&B, drill, Afro, Latin, house, pop, cinema, and Bay Area grooves. Selectable MPC C1 chromatic mapping covers Bank A Pads 1-16 on MIDI notes 36-51 while the released GM map remains available for existing sessions. WAV, AIFF, CAF, FLAC, MP3, and OGG loading plus live sidechain return are supported; user-owned third-party samples remain local and are not embedded in public installers.

presetDescriptions.WEST COAST BOUNCE: WEST COAST BOUNCE — Straight West Coast bounce: un-swung eighth-note hats, shaker glue, and a kick that drives the pocket. Use kick punch to move the groove forward. Starting point: 96 BPM, 32 steps, 0% swing, 22% Morph, 44% Governor.
